name: LV-Eval
intro: LV-Eval 是由 11 个中英双语单跳与多跳问答数据集组成的长上下文基准。9 个公开数据集贡献 1,329 个问答，另有中英文事实召回问答各 1 个，共 1,331 个独特问答对；事实召回在每种语言、每档长度使用 200 个证据位置，因此 16K、32K、64K、128K、256K 每档有 1,729 个实例，五档合计 8,645 个上下文。
org: Infinigence AI, Tsinghua University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
build_method: 混合, 人工标注, 大模型生成
metric: 论文 v3：9 个 AK 数据集先做答案关键词召回门控（中文 ≥ 0.2、英文 ≥ 0.4；未通过计 0），通过后计算黑名单感知 token F1；CMRC 独立使用黑名单感知中文 token F1；DuReader 独立使用黑名单感知 ROUGE-L
task_type: 单跳问答, 多跳问答
eval_feature: 16K–256K 五档可控长度（英文按词、中文按字）, CFI/KPR/AK 精确子集, 三路评测合同
scale: 8,645 个上下文 / 每档 1,729 个实例 / 1,331 个独特问答对 / 11 个数据集
eval_feature_en: Five controlled 16K–256K levels (English words, Chinese characters), exact CFI/KPR/AK subsets, three-route evaluation contract
intro_en: LV-Eval is a long-context benchmark of 11 bilingual single-hop and multi-hop QA datasets. Nine adapted public datasets contribute 1,329 QA pairs and one written FactRecall QA in each language brings the unique total to 1,331. FactRecall places each language's QA at 200 evidence positions per length, producing 1,729 instances at each of 16K, 32K, 64K, 128K, and 256K, or 8,645 contexts in total.
scale_en: 8,645 contexts / 1,729 instances per level / 1,331 unique QA pairs / 11 datasets
metric_en: Paper v3: nine AK datasets use answer-keyword recall gating (ZH ≥ 0.2, EN ≥ 0.4; failure scores 0) then blacklist-aware token F1; CMRC separately uses blacklist-aware Chinese token F1; DuReader separately uses blacklist-aware ROUGE-L

drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2402.05136v3 Sections 3.1–3.3 and Appendix B, official Git revision 63e7ae939bd347c76b2cdb1cebfb216faca26897, and Hugging Face dataset revision 86a3b0e6f2266281d481bcb46a0bda5b511cffb0. The main flow follows paper v3: 7 single-hop and 4 multi-hop datasets, 6 English and 5 Chinese; 1,329 adapted plus 2 written FactRecall QAs yield 1,331 unique QA pairs, while 200 evidence positions per FactRecall language and level produce 1,729 instances per level and 8,645 across five levels. Regular distractors come from unselected same-source QA contexts; HotpotQA and DuReader disperse multiple supports before sampling to length, shuffling, and Passage-i prefixing. CFI applies only to HotpotQA, LIC, MultiFieldQA EN/ZH, and FactRecall EN/ZH (557 instances): GPT-4 writes two similar but factually different facts and linguists remove contradictions or conflicts before random sentence-boundary insertion. KPR applies only to HotpotQA, CMRC, MultiFieldQA EN/ZH, and FactRecall EN/ZH, with 1,924 reviewed rules (232+786+476+424+3+3) replacing context and QA consistently. AK applies to nine datasets, excluding CMRC and DuReader, and covers 955 instances. Inference uses dataset-specific zero-shot direct-answer prompts, greedy decoding, 64 output tokens except 16 for FactRecall, and head-tail truncation when context exceeds the model window. Paper v3 then uses three metric routes: AK gating at ZH 0.2 / EN 0.4 followed by blacklist-aware token F1, blacklist-aware Chinese token F1 for CMRC, and blacklist-aware ROUGE-L for DuReader. The blacklist is derived from Llama2-7B and ChatGLM3 generations by ranking the 100 words most often overlapping ground truth, then retaining non-informative words by human review.
drawio_evidence_note: Paper v3 is the normative contract for the main diagram. Git and Hugging Face revisions are pinned for reproducibility; where released evaluator behavior differs from the paper, both are shown and the paper route remains primary.
drawio_artifact_boundary_note: The official release is test-only and publishes all labels. Code and nine datasets are MIT licensed; CMRC and LIC remain CC BY-SA 4.0. The official repository exposes a static README leaderboard rather than a verified live submission service, and the paper warns that public labels create overfitting risk. Released-artifact drift is explicit: repository thresholds are EN .2 / ZH .4 while paper v3 states ZH .2 / EN .4; released AK F1 does not fully apply blacklist filtering; FactRecall has null gold_ans and uses plain F1; paper loogle-MR appears as artifact loogle_MIR.
